architecture.title: Detect, contain, prove — where Module 08's controls sit
architecture.caption: Every tool call passes the policy enforcement point (PEP) and leaves one audit row: agent, tool, args, principal, outcome, chained by hash. A runtime monitor reads each row as it is written and can freeze an agent or quarantine a principal (the kill switch). Budgets in the runtime stop a delegation chain that grows too deep or too long. The witness head is anchored outside the log, where the agents cannot write. One manifest renders both the agents' prompts and the PEP allow-list. The monitor is detective: it sees a row after the tool ran; the PEP is what prevents.

sequence.title: A01 with the monitor on: detected, contained, not prevented
sequence.caption: Captured from Lab 08-2 (SIM brain, naive ensemble plus the monitor). The chiller change runs, its audit row trips the critical_for_non_staff rule, and the kill switch freezes the energy agent. The harm already happened; the halt stops the next call. An innocent guest's later request is refused too: that is the cost of a halt.
